observations: Large upright portable air cooler with wheeled base, white body and teal top strip with a logo.
Front has a round fan grille with vertical white slats over a dark fan guard.
Power cord with a UK-style plug lies loose, unplugged, on the floor in both photos.
No cooling pad, water tank fill point, or control panel clearly visible.
Body shows some surface dirt/scuffing, no major cracks visible.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BLESSING HYACINTH' overlays both images.

read_from: photo 1 teal top strip logo (partially legible, matches seller-stated brand)

claims.evidence: Teal strip logo in photo 1 is consistent with 'Scanfrost' branding but text is small/blurry, not fully crisp.
No power-on photo or video; cord is seen unplugged and lying on the floor in both shots.

claims.claim: designed to provide efficient and... (cut off)
claims.evidence: Marketing phrase, not a checkable fact from a photo.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or fan/motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: Short video of the cooler plugged in, fan spinning and cooling pad wet.

risks.risk: Cooling pad (honeycomb pad) could be missing, dried out, or moldy, which is central to an air cooler's function.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the open rear/side panel showing the cooling pad condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if pad is missing/damaged

risks.risk: Water tank could be cracked or leaking.
risks.proof: Photo of tank filled with water showing no leaks, or a short video.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (remote control, ice box, water pump) common on these models.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Electrical safety of plug/cord given it's shown loose and possibly worn.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of plug and cord insulation.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cord/plug may need replacement

proof_requests: Video of the cooler plugged in and running (fan + water pump operating).
Photo of the open pad compartment showing the cooling pad condition.
Photo of the water tank filled, checked for leaks.
Close-up of the brand/model label or sticker, if present.
response.reason: Item type and brand are reasonably identifiable from the photos, but working condition, pad condition, and accessory completeness are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
